stem: Nidhi loosens soil while transplanting a seedling. She sees sand grains, a worm, tiny living things, and bits of decayed leaves. She asks how such soil forms.

statements.text: Soil can contain sand, insects, worms, tiny organisms, and decayed plant and animal matter.
Soil forms immediately the first time water cracks a rock.
Soil forms over a long time as rocks break apart through the actions of the Sun, water, and living organisms.

teacher.key_rationale: Soil can contain sand, organisms, and decayed matter, and it forms slowly over a long time. It does not form immediately when water first cracks a rock.
